$comment: TF-C97 cross-ORIGIN named-type IDENTITY for shipped descriptors — the sqlite os_unix.c:7731 `conchModTime = buf.st_mtimespec;` shape that was the LAST error on the arm64-macho leg (`error[S0003] S_TypeMismatch got buf.st_mtimespec`). MEASURED root cause, which REFUTES the one first inferred: it is NOT that time.json and sys/stat.json intern two `timespec` TypeIds — those already collapse (the interner's complete-at-once path keys a composite on its FIELD CONTENT, and `ShippedTypeConsistency` would have fired otherwise; a TU including only those two headers compiles the same assignment clean, verified before the fix). The real second party is a SOURCE declaration of the tag: os_unix.c reaches the macOS SDK's sys/_types/_timespec.h through sys/fcntl.h, for which DSS ships no descriptor, and that tree-root tag binding SHADOWS the descriptor's cuRoot one — while `st_mtimespec` keeps the TypeId baked into it when sys/stat.json loaded. C 6.2.3 gives a file-scope tag exactly ONE type per TU, so the descriptor's own composite MEMBERS now adopt the source declaration's type, keyed (tag, THIS compilation) and therefore never across targets. ★ The pin is the ASSIGNMENT, never the tag resolution: a tag-resolution test stays GREEN with the defect present, because the binding was never the wrong one — the member was. ★ Not a compile-only witness: `conchModTime` is poisoned to -1, so exit 42 needs the 16 bytes to actually move; the run reads both nested members back, cross-checks them against the c107 explicit-offset OVERLAY twins st_mtim_sec/st_mtim_nsec (same 16 bytes at offset 48), then writes through the nested members to compose 40 + 2. RED-ON-DISABLE (MEASURED, no binary): revert the member adoption in semantic_analyzer.cpp and the original S0003 returns on the assignment line; narrow the source declaration to `int tv_sec; int tv_nsec;` and the layouts stop agreeing, so the unification is REFUSED and error[F_ShippedTypeIdentityConflict] names both sizes (16/align 8 vs 8/align 4) — the fail-loud arm reusing the existing cross-declaration identity diagnostic. Single arm64-macho target → the macos-latest CI leg (st_mtimespec lives only in the `when:{format:macho}` variant of `struct stat`). Release arm runs the optimizer over the composite copy.
